run_nr_baseline_pipeline: run the nr_baseline script to process documents through a multi-stage LLM curation pipeline using Ray
run_NRInference_process_single_row: run the NRInference process_single_row method to filter, score, and generate exam questions from a document row
run_NRInference_call: run the NRInference call method to process a batch of rows concurrently through the LLM pipeline
run_run_remotely: run the run_remotely Ray remote function to read JSON data and map it through the NRInference pipeline
run_main: run the main entry point to initialize Ray, fetch LLM metadata, and execute the nr_baseline curation job
